changelogEntries.2026-10-19-runtime-extension-switches: Superadmins can switch whole extension packages on or off for single organizations or users under "Feature Flags", without a redeploy.
changelogEntries.2026-10-14-french-language-menu: BenGER is now also available in French. You choose the language from the flag menu at the top right (previously a toggle between German and English); date and number formats follow the chosen language.
changelogEntries.2026-10-13-evaluations-limited-model-ans: Evaluations can be limited to model answers: with no annotator selected only the model answers are graded (and with no model only the submitted answers). The cost estimate now counts only the selected metrics, models, annotators and prompt structures.
changelogEntries.2026-10-13-api-access-organizations-pers: New: API access for organizations and for you personally. Under "API access" you create keys for scripts and benchmark runners, pick with a preset what they may do, and check them right away with "Test connection". Keys can be renewed, revoked and their usage tracked.
changelogEntries.2026-10-12-belong-several-organizations-: If you belong to several organizations on a project that provide API keys, "Billed to" in the generation and evaluation dialogs lets you choose which organization pays for the model calls. The choice also applies to single re-runs and is remembered per project.
changelogEntries.2026-10-09-tasks-row-shows-result: Under "My Tasks" every row now shows the result of your submission: grade points, for a grading sheet also the points per sheet, passed or not, and whether the grading is still running. Clicking the row opens the full grading of that task in full screen. The result block above the list is gone in return.
changelogEntries.2026-10-09-project-settings-decide-separ: The project settings now let you decide separately from the reference solution whether annotators see the individual steps of their grading after submitting, that is the points and reason for each step of the grading sheet. The reference solution can stay hidden while the grading remains easy to follow.
changelogEntries.2026-10-08-api-keys-set-per: Under "API keys" you can now set per group who pays for AI calls on the group's projects: the same as the organization, the organization (with the group key first, else the organization-wide key), or the members with their own keys. An organization can, for example, provide keys for a single chair only. Organization admins and the group's admins can change it.
changelogEntries.2026-10-08-legal-experience-profile-ente: Under "Legal Experience" in your profile you can now enter the German state where you take or took your Staatsexamen.
changelogEntries.2026-10-07-clicking-model-model-list: Clicking a model in the model list or on the LLM leaderboard now opens an overview of its evaluation scores across every project you can access: per project and metric the mean with confidence interval and sample size, switchable by period. Until now the click only showed the technical settings as JSON; those remain available under "Technical details".
changelogEntries.2026-10-07-writing-annotations-exams-not: While writing annotations and exams, a notice now appears when your draft can no longer be saved on the server, for example because the connection dropped. The text stays in your browser and is sent automatically once the connection is back. Until now saving failed without any notice.
changelogEntries.2026-10-07-models-choose-claude-opus: New models to choose from: Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, Grok 4.7, Mistral Large 4, plus DeepSeek V4 Pro (0813), MiMo V2.6 Pro and Flash, Qwen3.8 27B, gpt-oss-120b and Llama 3.3 70B again. Models their provider has shut down or is about to shut down are no longer available, among them GLM-5 and 5.1, Kimi K2.5, MiniMax M2.7, Llama 4 Maverick, Devstral, o3-mini, o4-mini and GPT-4.1 nano. The prices of GLM-5.3, Gemma 4 31B and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning were corrected. For OpenAI GPT-5 models the selected reasoning level now also applies to generations without structured output; until now it was ignored there. GPT-6 Astra can now be used; requests to it failed until now.
changelogEntries.2026-10-06-publicly-shared-projects-visi: In publicly shared projects, visitors without editing rights now see the other participants under their pseudonym and without their email address, unless they turned their pseudonym off. Until now real names were visible there.
changelogEntries.2026-10-06-group-organization-own-roles: Every group of an organization now has its own roles: admin, contributor or annotator, independent of the organization role. On a group’s projects the group role counts, on organization-wide projects the organization role. So someone can sit exams in one chair and run projects in another. Whoever is admin of a group manages its members and roles, invites new people into the group and creates projects there, even as an annotator of the organization. When inviting into a group you choose the group role; existing organization members are added to the group directly, and the result names every skipped address with its reason. Imported projects can be assigned to a group too.
changelogEntries.2026-09-30-sign-yourself-invitation-same: If you sign up yourself while an invitation to the same address is open, you now also join the inviting organization when an administrator verifies your address or you prove it via “Forgot password” or account activation. Until now this only worked through the verification link. Invitations can also be accepted when the address was entered in different upper and lower case.
changelogEntries.2026-09-30-platform-cannot-load-keys: When the platform cannot load the keys of the learning platform during a launch from Moodle or ILIAS, for example because a firewall blocks it, the error page now shows its own code jwks_unreachable. Until now this appeared as invalid_token, although the tool settings were often correct. The help names the addresses the learning platform administration has to open.
changelogEntries.2026-09-26-grading-sheets-outline-such: Grading sheets with an outline, such as uploaded sheets or sheets made in the editor, now name the grade key the exam is graded with in the task data. Until now they showed the standard key when the sheet had none of its own, even if the exam uses a different key. The entry updates when the sheet is activated or edited, and now also whenever the exam’s grade key changes. AI-generated sheets still appear there as their generated text, without the grade key.
changelogEntries.2026-09-26-ai-grading-grading-sheet: AI grading with a grading sheet checks quotes from the answer more strictly for negations, contrary results, numbers and bare norm citations. It can now match more quotes that combine several passages or run across a hyphenation break. The AI is also instructed to credit correct work under another heading of the same question to the matching step.
changelogEntries.2026-09-24-data-management-mark-complete: In data management, “Mark as complete” and “Mark as incomplete” work again. The table shows the new status right away, and moving between pages works again.
changelogEntries.2026-09-24-models-page-custom-models: On the Models page, custom models now appear at the top. The “Register model” button sits above the filter bar, like on the other pages.
changelogEntries.2026-09-19-sign-password-reset-recognise: Sign-in and password reset now recognise your email address regardless of upper or lower case. Until now, signing in as “T.Name@…” instead of “t.name@…” failed, and the reset email never arrived.
changelogEntries.2026-09-19-organizations-listed-alphabet: Organizations are listed alphabetically in the organization switcher and the account menu. The switcher on the Organizations page looks like the other dropdowns, closes on a click outside or Esc, and works with the arrow keys.
changelogEntries.2026-09-17-pending-invitation-list-shows: The pending invitation list now shows whether the invitation email really went out, and names the reason when it did not. Invitations can be resent without cancelling and recreating them. A link already sent keeps working.
changelogEntries.2026-09-17-member-lists-show-roles: Member lists show roles by their label, and the grading tab for grading sheets has a label. The ILIAS guides now recommend identifying people without their email address, because ILIAS 10.9 otherwise accepts no grades.
changelogEntries.2026-09-17-registering-learning-platform: Registering a learning platform by link now shows its result right inside Moodle. The guides also name the three tool settings the Moodle administration changes afterwards. The tool then appears in the activity chooser, opens in a new window and may enter grades.
changelogEntries.2026-09-17-projects-task-assignments-imp: Projects with task assignments can be imported again. Until now, such an import stopped with an error.
changelogEntries.2026-09-17-people-removed-organization-i: People removed from an organization can be invited again. Accepting the invitation makes the membership active again. Until now, accepting failed with an error.
changelogEntries.2026-09-17-organization-admins-set-manag: Organization admins now set up and manage Moodle and ILIAS connections themselves under Users & organizations → More → Learning platform (LTI). New connections are active at once, the tool address can be chosen per connection, and the panel shows activities, LMS accounts, grade transfers and a history. Accounts created through the learning platform can be anonymized. Group admins manage their group’s connections.
changelogEntries.2026-09-17-contributors-admins-organizat: Contributors and admins of an organization see exams linked to a learning platform of the organization and can grade them, even when the exam is private. The link gives nobody the right to delete the exam. People from the learning platform appear under their pseudonym in member lists, task lists and exports. Only admins, the teachers of the linked courses and those who may grade the exam see real names.
changelogEntries.2026-09-17-guides-learning-platform-inte: The guides on the learning platform integration were revised. New guides cover managing a connection and grades from the learning platform, and the help on failed launches from Moodle or ILIAS gives cause, fix and contact for every error code. The privacy policy now also describes the processing for the integration.
changelogEntries.2026-09-16-guides-include-data-protectio: The guides now include one on data protection for the LMS integration (Moodle, ILIAS) and link out to the detailed technical reference for university IT. The topic list on the left can also be scrolled now when it is longer than the window.
changelogEntries.2026-09-16-models-choose-gpt-6: New models to choose from: GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, Gemini 3.7 and 3.8 Flash, Grok 4.6, plus Kimi K3, GLM-5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Qwen3.8 Flash and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning. Mistral Large is no longer available, and the prices of several models were corrected.
changelogEntries.2026-09-15-exams-worked-stay-viewable: Exams you have worked on stay viewable with your submission, grading and any released model solution, even after the time window closed, the project was archived or your organization changed.
changelogEntries.2026-09-15-notification-settings-entries: The notification settings have new entries for gradings of your own submissions, such as AI gradings and evaluation runs. Email notifications now also arrive when in-app notifications are switched off.
changelogEntries.2026-09-15-evaluation-run-page-opens: The evaluation run page now opens immediate gradings after a submission, and the Judges tab shows each judge run with the mean of its own metric.
changelogEntries.2026-09-15-project-page-participation-ca: On the project page the Participation card now sits below the quick actions and stays hidden when there is nothing to leave and no cohort to show.
changelogEntries.2026-09-15-local-drafts-bound-signed: Local drafts are now bound to the signed-in account: a second account in the same browser no longer sees them, and they are removed on sign-out.
changelogEntries.2026-09-15-evaluation-run-page-matches: The evaluation run page now matches the rest of the app: project title instead of its id, translated status, readable metric names, readable reference and answer text, and explained reasons when a run found nothing to grade.
changelogEntries.2026-09-15-project-import-keeps-project: Project import now keeps the project kind, icon and settings such as time limit and checkpoints, creates the project in the organization you are working in, and rejects task exports with a pointer to the Project data page.
changelogEntries.2026-09-15-metric-catalogue-task-positio: The metric catalogue, the task position and the elapsed time on the labeling page now follow the interface language. Creating a project shows a single success message, and projects without a description no longer show placeholder text.
changelogEntries.2026-09-15-personal-api-keys-provider: Personal API keys that the provider rejects are now refused when saving, and the message shows the reason.
changelogEntries.2026-09-15-uploaded-word-files-longer: Uploaded Word files no longer leave table-of-contents links and hidden bookmarks in the extracted text.
changelogEntries.2026-09-15-cost-estimate-grading-sheet: The cost estimate for grading-sheet judges now counts the full judge prompt including sheet and answer, and its notes follow the interface language.
changelogEntries.2026-09-08-tidier-toolbar-users-organiza: Tidier toolbar on “Users & Organizations”: next to the organization picker only “Groups”, “API keys” and a “More” menu (cloud storage, learning-platform integration) remain; superadmins additionally see “Create organization”.
changelogEntries.2026-09-03-public-projects-hardened-publ: Public projects hardened: on public projects, only members with edit rights can change the evaluation configuration, launch evaluation runs, edit task metadata or create exports. Outside users still see only what their role allows.
changelogEntries.2026-09-02-reports-rebuilt-reports-publi: Reports rebuilt: reports can now be published publicly (readable without signing in), show models by display name with correct ranking and grade points, keep judge configurations apart, and visualize how grade points are distributed across humans and models. Numbers are frozen on publish and can be refreshed deliberately.
changelogEntries.2026-09-02-architecture-page-updated-ope: Architecture page updated: open-core structure (platform + extensions), the two interfaces BenGER and Vertretbar, worker queues, object storage, groups, LTI and the current deployment and CI flow.
changelogEntries.2026-09-02-guides-how-guides-page: New guides: the "How-to guides" page is now a searchable catalog of short question-and-answer guides (organizations & groups, projects, data import, annotation XML, API keys, evaluation methods, Moodle/ILIAS, troubleshooting). The header search now finds every page and every individual guide.
changelogEntries.2026-09-02-generation-placeholders-such-: Generation: placeholders such as $sachverhalt inside a prompt text are now replaced with the task content. Previously the placeholder was sent to the model literally.
changelogEntries.2026-09-02-landing-page-group-network: Landing page: the "Group & Network" section now lists everyone involved in one block; the benchmark citation is marked as a preprint accepted at EMNLP 2026.
changelogEntries.2026-09-02-top-right-context-menu: Top-right context menu: long organization names are now cut to one line with "…" (full name as tooltip) instead of wrapping and squeezing the icon.
changelogEntries.2026-09-02-leaderboards-exam-cohort-tab: Leaderboards: the "Exam cohort" tab is gone. Human rankings live under "Human Annotators"; the per-exam cohort ranking stays on the project page. The learning statistics page now uses the same page spacing as the other pages.
changelogEntries.2026-09-01-organizations-split-members-p: Organizations can now split members, projects, and API keys into groups (e.g. chairs) — groups only see their own projects and spend their own keys; group admins manage their group themselves.
changelogEntries.2026-08-31-project-page-billing-card: Project page: new "Billing" card shows whose API key pays for AI evaluations.
changelogEntries.2026-08-31-cloud-storage-import-organiza: Cloud storage import: organizations can connect S3-compatible storage and import files from the bucket as tasks.
changelogEntries.2026-08-31-project-wizard-clearer-data: Project wizard: clearer data-source picker — for exam projects "Enter exam" now comes first, and paste is labeled for what it is.
changelogEntries.2026-08-31-project-wizard-enter-exam: Project wizard: "Enter exam" now saves entered content automatically — the exam task is no longer lost when "Apply" was skipped.
changelogEntries.2026-08-31-organization-management-edite: Organization management: an edited description now shows immediately, without reloading the page.
changelogEntries.2026-08-25-ai-grading-rubric-own: The AI grading rubric is now its own project-wizard step (experimental) and works for any exam, not just AI-generated ones.
changelogEntries.2026-08-25-everyone-switch-between-stude: Everyone can now switch between the student and expert interface from the account menu.
changelogEntries.2026-08-25-project-type-exam-flashcard: The project type (exam / flashcard deck) is now editable in the project details and controls student visibility.
changelogEntries.2026-08-24-changelog-page-overview-whats: New changelog page: an overview of what's new, reachable from the footer.
